reuse.why: Reuses assertBankAccountNotLinked, findOrCreateBank and the new finishAccountLink tail, but the upgrade-or-insert account body and the download function are copied from existing providers rather than shared.

duplication.why: It removes the duplicated sync-response/notify tail from all six link functions, yet linkFintegraAccount's upgrade/insert/payee/sync body copies linkEnableBankingAccount and downloadFintegraTransactions copies downloadAkahuTransactions.

placement.why: Link handler and helper in accounts/app.ts, download in sync.ts, URL in server-config, account type in its own models/fintegra.ts exported from the index, matching the other providers.

scope.why: The finishAccountLink refactor touches five existing providers beyond the request, though it is a small, behaviour-preserving consolidation.

maintainability.why: Clean provider addition with an explicit tables parameter preserving akahu's variation; the larger copied link body remains as in the rest of the file.

disguised_duplication.where: downloadFintegraTransactions reshapes downloadAkahuTransactions (destructuring instead of retVal assignment, error branch dropped) rather than sharing it.
